# Yigrid

Yigrid is the female yak musician from Yakyakistan who helps Pinkie Pie rediscover the joy of playing music in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. She is the accomplished yovidaphone player, not Yona the student.

- **Appearance:** Muted gray-brown and lighter beige-gray coloring; recognizable by her large, bagpipe-like yovidaphone. [Character catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_non-pony_characters/Bovines#Yigrid).
- **Name and voice:** Yigrid is her official television name: she refers to herself by name in dialogue, and Patricia Drake is credited as her English voice actor. [Season eight credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_eight#Yakity-Sax). No alternate identity is verified.
- **Appearance in the series:** *Yakity-Sax* (S8E18), first previewed July 20, 2018, with its scheduled airing August 25, 2018. No additional appearance was verified. [Episode guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Yakity-Sax).

## Important moments

All three occur in *Yakity-Sax* (S8E18). [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n2t1HgtvrY4) (scene timestamps unavailable); [dialogue transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Yakity-Sax).

- **Music in Yakyakistan:** Her skilled performance is what Pinkie has come to hear after giving up her own instrument.
- **Entrusting Pinkie with the instrument:** Yigrid asks Pinkie to watch her yovidaphone during a break, giving Pinkie the chance to rediscover her enjoyment.
- **Happiness over perfection:** After Pinkie's discordant performance, Yigrid praises her and explains that playing for happiness is what makes it perfect.

**Images:** A [2018 discussion post identifying Yigrid](https://www.gtplanet.net/forum/threads/the-thread-about-ponies-logistics-and-general-weirdness-and-gilda.198206/post-12409436) was found, but its image asset could not be verified. No unverified image or artist credit is embedded.
